title: Data pillar Form tab: a compact Layout / Preview control with Add section and Add field at the right, field cards with a type tag and a selection ring, and a dashed "Add a section" footer
body:
## Source

Epic objectstack-ai/objectui#12446, decisions 1 and 3. Measured on objectui main `a2225f91`, Data pillar, Form tab for `crm_account`: a second sub-tab row (Layout / Preview) with a trailing badge sentence, then an info strip, then a bordered card per section ("Basic Information") whose fields are bordered boxes with the label, a type word and a disabled input — five nesting levels under the object header. Section settings is an icon at the card's right; there is no "add" affordance in the toolbar.

## Target

Under the object header and tab row of the Data pillar card:

1. **Form toolbar**, 12 px vertical padding, white, bottom border: a compact segmented control (24 px items) Layout / Preview; a 12 px muted hint "Drag fields to arrange · click a field to edit its properties"; at the right "Add section" (outline chip) and "Add field" (primary-soft chip), both 28 px. The badge sentences of today's Layout / Preview row move into the control's titles; the read-only card owns the read-only strip.
2. **Canvas**, sidebar-tinted, 24 px padding, 16 px between sections.
3. **Section card**: white, 1 px border, 8 px radius; a 44 px header with a 14 px / 600 title, "N fields" at 12 px muted, a drag grip at the left and the section settings icon button at the right; a 3-column grid body (`repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))`, 8 px gap, 12 px padding). A field that spans (textarea, rich text) takes two columns.
4. **Field card**: 10 px by 12 px padding, 6 px radius, transparent border that turns muted on hover; a 13 px / 500 label (red asterisk when required), a 10 px uppercase type tag beside it, then a 32 px skeleton input (56 px for textarea; a select skeleton with a chevron for picklists). Selected: 1 px primary border plus a 3 px primary-soft ring; the type tag turns primary.
5. **Footer**: a dashed 44 px "Add a section" button under the last section.

Drag-and-drop, keyboard reordering and their announcements (objectui#11802, #11871, #11898) are untouched; only presentation moves.

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectFormDesigner.tsx`, `ObjectGroupInspector.tsx` (trigger only), `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (the Form tab's sub-tab row and strips), `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` (the new toolbar hint; existing `engine.studio.data.form.*` keys stay).

## Acceptance

1. The Form tab shows exactly one toolbar row between the object tab row and the first section card.
2. Selected field shows the ring; the selection opens the field inspector exactly as today (`DataPillar.inspectorBelongsToView-11781` stays green).
3. `ObjectFormDesigner.test.tsx`, `dndAnnouncements-11802`, `keyboardDrop-11871`, `keyboardGrid-11898`, `roleDescription-11872`, `readOnlyDescription-11924`, `ObjectGroupInspector.test.tsx`, `DataPillar.layoutBadge.test.tsx` stay green or are updated in the same PR for the moved badge, each ablated once.
4. Before/after screenshots, light and dark.

## Constraints

- Tailwind utilities and theme tokens only; no inline style.
- Existing `data-testid`s and i18n keys stay.
- Gates: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test`, `lint`, `build`.
- Lands after the shared inspector card and the Data pillar card (the Blocked-by lines below).
